title: Critically finite maps with hyperbolic postcritical complement
exact_target: Find nontrivial critically finite projective maps with a Kobayashi-hyperbolic postcritical complement, and describe their dynamics.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300089 (AMR-052-0089). CC BY 4.0.
